Tag names are lowercase and singular and may contain spaces. model_label_map translates detector labels to tags, matched case-insensitively; any label not in it is dropped. v2 (28 Oct): Rekognition label names confirmed from a 30-image pilot (tools/testset). Frog, Amphibian, Hare, Canine, Coyote and Wolf are left out on purpose because they also fire on lookalikes (tree frogs, hares, foxes vs dogs).
